description: Full-service restaurant operator with Olive Garden, LongHorn Steakhouse, and other chains.

catalyst.facts_line: 2026-09-24 (Thursday, before the open), 5 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 2.05.
catalyst.why: The report must show Olive Garden traffic gains and reaffirmed fiscal 2027 guidance, proving Darden is taking share despite weak industry traffic.

reasons: Net income rose 32% and revenue 11.2% last quarter while industry real sales grow only 1.3%, so Darden is taking share from independents.
At 16.9x next-fiscal-year EPS, Darden trades below Cheesecake Factory and BJ's, which have rallied on similar traffic and margin gains, yet Darden adds a $1.5B buyback and 32% net income growth.
Darden's value menus and scale let it hold traffic while consumers favor local restaurants, so its 11.2% revenue growth can continue even as industry traffic falls.

structuring.thesis_target: Targets the 2026-12-24 report, with the long leg expiring 2027-01-15, which gives the thesis time to show up.
structuring.reflection: The 15.2% conservative credit ratio clears the floor, but the short October 220 calls cap upside into the catalyst. Net debit $3,330 is modest; the risk is a post-earnings pop through 220 that forces early assignment.
